title: Xiezhi: An Ever-Updating Benchmark for Holistic Domain Knowledge Evaluation
reasoning: The benchmark is named Xiezhi, after a mythical creature symbolizing fairness and judgement. The paper explicitly states the benchmark aims to "uphold justice" and "conform to human values" in its construction. The Appendix includes a section titled "Bias, Ethical Problems and Social Impact" and a subsection "Gender, Race, Religion, National Discrimination or Prejudice", detailing extensive efforts to remove biased, discriminatory, and sensitive content to ensure the benchmark aligns with ethical principles.
